references.text: Samson cries out to the Lord in distress and asks for strength, just as he did at Lehi when he was thirsty after killing the Philistines.
The Spirit of the Lord began to stir Samson, and this is the power he now asks to receive one last time.
The Spirit of the Lord came upon Samson with power, and he now asks for that same supernatural strength.
A prayer that God would avenge the blood of his people, just as Samson asks for vengeance for his eyes.
Vengeance belongs to the Lord, and Samson leaves vengeance to God by asking for His strength.
Samson is mentioned among heroes of faith who through faith became strong and overcame enemies.
The Lord gives power to the weary and strength to those without might, just as Samson asks for strength in his weakness.
A prayer to the Lord not to remain silent, just as Samson cries out to God in his desperation.
